question.problem:
Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{D}9{x}^{2}{y}^{2}\,\text{d}A,$ where 
$D=\{(x,y)\,:\,-2\le x\le 2,\,-1\le y\le 1\}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, we express our double integral as a repeated integral:        

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}9{x}^{2}{y}^{2}\,\text{d}A & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}[{\int }_{-2}^{2}9{x}^{2}{y}^{2}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x$, treating $y$ as a constant:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-1}^{1}[{\int }_{-2}^{2}9{x}^{2}{y}^{2}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}9{y}^{2}[{\int }_{-2}^{2}{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}9{y}^{2}{[\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}]}_{-2}^{2}\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}9{y}^{2}(\frac{{2}^{3}}{3}-\frac{(-2)^{3}}{3})\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}9{y}^{2}\cdot \frac{16}{3}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{-1}^{1}48{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-1}^{1}48{y}^{2}\,\text{d}y & =[16{y}^{3}]_{-1}^{1} \\  & =16({1}^{3}-(-1)^{3}) \\  & =16\cdot 2 \\  & =32\end{aligned}
$$
